message.content:
Build MONITORING + a real STATUS-PAGE backend + a DISK-CAPACITY guard for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; admin `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `await requireArea("fleet")`. Proxmox: `import { pve, node, pveFor } from "@/lib/proxmox"` (READ it — read-only calls: node status/storage via `GET /nodes/{node}/status` and `/nodes/{node}/storage`). Design: `.card`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, MeterBar } from "@/components/ui/primitives"` (+ charts). `Server`, `Job`, `Node` models exist. Notifications: `db.notification.create({ data:{ userId, title, body?, href? } })` — for admin alerts, target ADMIN users (`db.user.findMany({where:{role:"ADMIN"}})`).

## TASK
1. **Health API** `app/api/health/route.ts` — returns JSON `{ web, db, worker, proxmox }` each `{ status: "operational"|"degraded"|"down", detail }`: db = a trivial query; worker = most-recent Job update within ~2 min (stale ⇒ degraded/down); proxmox = a read-only node status call; web = "operational" (it's responding). No auth (safe, no secrets) but cache ~15s.
2. **Real status page** — EDIT `app/status/page.tsx` (replace the placeholder): server-component that calls the health logic (import from `lib/monitoring.ts`) and renders real component statuses + an overall banner. Keep it public + clean.
3. **Monitoring sweep** `worker/monitor.ts` exports `monitorSweep()`: checks and, when a threshold trips, notifies all ADMINs (dedupe so it doesn't spam — e.g. once per issue per few hours via a recent-notification check): node disk usage > 85% (from Proxmox storage), worker/stale-job (a Job stuck RUNNING > 15 min), oldest backup age (from `/tank/backup` listing via Proxmox storage content if available, else skip), pending-job backlog. (Orchestrator calls `monitorSweep()` in the worker loop.)
4. **Disk-capacity guard** — add `diskCapacityCheck(nodeId, addDiskGB)` to `lib/capacity.ts` (EDIT — it currently has a RAM guard; mirror that style) returning `{ ok, reason }` by summing committed disk vs the node's usable storage with a safety ratio. (Orchestrator calls it at order time.)
5. **Admin monitoring** — EDIT `app/admin/monitoring/page.tsx` to surface node disk/RAM usage bars, worker health, stuck jobs, and oldest-backup age (read-only). `lib/monitoring.ts` holds the shared read-only helpers.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `lib/monitoring.ts`, `worker/monitor.ts`, `app/api/health/route.ts`. EDIT (sole owner): `app/status/page.tsx`, `app/admin/monitoring/page.tsx`, `lib/capacity.ts`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch layouts/Shell/schema/next.config/rbac/db/auth/lib/proxmox.ts(read-only import)/worker/index.ts/worker/billing.ts/lib/actions.ts/ROADMAP/docs/sitemap or others' files. Read-only Proxmox only. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created/edited; what health/status/monitor/disk-guard do; INTEGRATION NEEDED (call `monitorSweep()` in the worker loop; call `diskCapacityCheck()` at order time in lib/actions.ts); risks / what needs live Proxmox testing.

Added `HOST_DISK_GB`/`DISK_SAFETY_RATIO` consts.

**What each does**
- **Health API/logic**: db = `SELECT 1`; worker = inferred from the Job queue (stale QUEUED work past 2m ⇒ down, RUNNING stuck >15m ⇒ degraded, empty/fresh queue ⇒ operational); proxmox = read-only `/nodes/{node}/status` across all enabled nodes (any reachable ⇒ up, some unreachable ⇒ degraded); web = operational.
- **monitorSweep**: checks node disk >85%, node RAM >90%, stuck RUNNING jobs >15m, worker-stopped + QUEUED backlog ≥25, and backup staleness (newest backup older than 48h).
